about: I'm an educator, researcher and former software engineer who is passionate about improving how we teach and learn.

At the University of Melbourne, I explore how AI, learning analytics and educational technologies can make education more meaningful, inclusive and effective. My work is grounded in real educational challenges, with a focus on turning research into practical solutions that benefit students and educators.
